---
title: Pilot
subtitle: test
format:
    html:
        # Per-format output names. A single top-level `output-file: index.html`
        # would make typst emit "index.html.pdf" — a double extension that some
        # servers and embedded PDF viewers fail to resolve.
        output-file: index.html
        toc: true
        number-sections: true
        number-depth: 3
        link-external-icon: true
        title-block-banner: "#0033A0"
        title-block-banner-color: "#FFFFFF"
        lightbox: true
    typst:
        output-file: pilot.pdf
        toc: true
        toc-depth: 3
        number-sections: true
        fig-align: center
        section-numbering: 1.1.1
format-links:
  # The bare `html` entry matters: a format-links list made up only of objects
  # is treated as extra custom links, so Quarto keeps its auto-generated
  # "Typst" link as well and the menu shows the same PDF twice. Including a
  # plain format name switches it to filtering, and the object below then
  # relabels typst rather than duplicating it.
  - html
  - format: typst
    text: PDF
    icon: file-pdf
---
